title: (Esp/Killall/Fly/silentaim)
features:
Total War Cheat – Feature List (NEW)
Aimbot

Enable toggle, rebindable key (default F)
Aim mode: Camera / Mouse
Activation: Hold / Toggle
FOV, Smoothing, Sensitivity sliders
Team & visibility/wall checks (skip teammates, ignore non-visible)
Dead/KO skip
Priority: Nearest / Closest to Mouse / Both, with low‑HP tie‑breaker
Velocity‑based prediction with real‑frame delta
Sticky targeting (holds last valid target)
Kill credit via Humanoid.Died
ESP (Players)

Enable toggle
Box styles: full rectangle / corner brackets; rounded corners emulated via line path
Name, distance/health, health bar (text)
Text scale & anti‑aliasing
Team color and team/wall checks (non‑visible grayed out)
Highlight for enemies only (visible, occluded depth)
Hide dead/KO
Tracers (single line)
Spawnpoint ESP (off by default)
Visuals

Fullbright, No Fog (classic + atmosphere), No DoF/Blur
Potato Graphics (QualityLevel.Level01)
Clear View preset: Bloom 0.35, Godrays off, DoF/Blur off, Atmosphere 0.15
FOV changer with slider
Crosshair

Toggle + color picker
FOV Circle

Toggle (on by default), color picker, 64‑segment line ring (opaque)
Winner Cat

Toggle (on by default)
Spawns cat image on credited kill; off‑center, 1s visible + 3s fade, multiple cats supported
Startup

10% chance easter egg (auto‑dismiss in 4s)
Load notification (RightShift = UI, F = aim key)
